blurb: `@build` on a `Container` is a directory inside the project, written relative to the project root with `/` separators: `@build("containers/renderer")`. An empty path, an absolute path, a drive path, a path with `\` and a path that leaves the project with `..` are refused, so the build context can never reach outside the project and the emitted configuration stays a function of the source.
example:
capability Renderer = Container @build("../renderer") @port(8080)       // ✗ leaves the project
capability Renderer = Container @build("containers/renderer") @port(8080) // ✓
summary: A `Container`'s `@build` is not a directory inside the project: it is empty, absolute, uses `\`, or leaves the project with `..`.
